entities.name: Query protein 268 aa
observations: Sequence length is 268 aa; estimated molecular weight is 29.13 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.38.
Contains Pfam Ubie_methyltran (PF01209.25) spanning residues 40–267 with i-Evalue 1.1e-79.
Also matches methyltransferase-related Pfams PF13847, PF08241, and PF13649 in the central region.

entities.name: UbiE
observations: Reviewed Swiss-Prot homolog A5FZ96 from Acidiphilium cryptum shares 69.3% identity and 91.0% query coverage with the query sequence.
Reviewed UbiE homologs are annotated as ubiquinone/menaquinone biosynthesis C-methyltransferases.
Homology supports assignment of the query as UbiE, but exact substrate usage remains inference from homologs.

entities.name: UbiE quinone C-methylation
observations: UbiE homologs transfer a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to demethylmenaquinol or a methoxy polyprenyl benzoquinol substrate, producing the corresponding methylated quinone and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Reference reactions include EC 2.1.1.163 and EC 2.1.1.201; Rhea mappings include RHEA:42640 and RHEA:28286.

entities.name: Menaquinone biosynthesis
observations: UbiE catalyzes the terminal C-methylation step in menaquinone biosynthesis from demethylmenaquinol to menaquinol.
The related activity can also participate in ubiquinone biosynthesis, depending on organism and pathway repertoire.
Associated biological process annotations include aerobic respiration and menaquinone biosynthetic process.
